unknown_policy: Report unmapped source tiles; never infer walls from walkable=false

render_contract.collision: always original MAP collision; mapping adds no collision or event
render_contract.tile_sampling: tile materials sample a continuous world-aligned region; do not repeat the full texture each cell
render_contract.module_part: module.size and module.part partition one full prop into grid pieces; one source fragment is not a whole prop
render_contract.hidden_content: do not add chest, glow, arrow or marker to invisible source objects
render_contract.edge: Named edge is a source-shape requirement for the matching asset family; not permission to draw arbitrary full props.
render_contract.conditional_assets: Evaluate listed when fields only in the specific map override; original logical collision does not change.
render_contract.asset_status: required_asset_missing_from_initial_catalog means semantic mapping known but matching new art required; never silently use an unrelated texture.

coverage.source_scope: twenty distinct first-chapter MAP resources including optional cemetery; scene scripts may share MAPs

visual_status: source shapes mapped; replacement art still pending current user style review
